# Meow.Cro

> Meow.Cro is an independent crochet studio making small-batch, handmade accessories, floral pieces, plushies, and thoughtful gifts.

Meow.Cro offers a curated collection of crochet goods and accepts custom requests. Each piece is handmade, so small variations between items are part of the craft.

## Start here

- [Home]({{SITE_ORIGIN}}/): Meet the studio and browse featured creations.
- [Shop]({{SITE_ORIGIN}}/shop.html): Browse the current product catalogue and prices.
- [Our story]({{SITE_ORIGIN}}/story.html): Learn about the studio and its handmade process.
- [Custom orders]({{SITE_ORIGIN}}/custom.html): Submit an idea for a custom crochet piece.
- [Frequently asked questions]({{SITE_ORIGIN}}/faq.html): Read answers about products, orders, shipping, and custom requests.
- [Contact]({{SITE_ORIGIN}}/contact.html): Contact the Meow.Cro studio.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Treat the shop page as the source of truth for current products, descriptions, and prices; catalogue details can change.
- Do not imply that a custom request is accepted until the studio confirms it.
- Handmade product photos and descriptions may not represent every small variation in an individual item.
- Link to the original Meow.Cro pages when citing product or policy information.

For expanded studio and catalogue information, see [llms-full.txt]({{SITE_ORIGIN}}/llms-full.txt).
